resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Bengali source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Bengali pass identified 25 actionable formula, terminology, loanword, and technical-clarity defects across electrical, heating, trigonometric, thermal, and unit-check content; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Bengali human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The current formula omitted spacing around division.
evidence: The previous expression was ‘I = V/R’.
findings.resolution: Restored the standard protected spacing in ‘I = V / R’.

findings.summary: The resistance formula omitted spacing around the equality and division operators.
evidence: The previous expression was ‘R=V/I’.
findings.resolution: Restored ‘R = V / I’.

findings.summary: The voltage example conclusion was less consistent than the protected formula notation.
evidence: The previous conclusion used a prose-only voltage result.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the concise ‘ভোল্টেজ হল 5 V।’

findings.summary: The heating title used an unnatural literal word order.
evidence: The previous title was ‘কি গরম প্রভাবিত করে’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the natural Bengali title ‘উত্তাপকে কী প্রভাবিত করে’.

findings.summary: The constant-resistance bullet used the vague phrase গরম করার শক্তি.
evidence: The previous bullet described ‘গরম করার শক্তি’ rather than heating power.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the precise term উত্তাপের ক্ষমতা and stated the fourfold relationship.

findings.summary: The constant-current bullet used inconsistent resistance and heating terminology.
evidence: The previous bullet mixed প্রবাহ and প্রতিরোধ ক্ষমতা with heating power.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with কারেন্ট, রোধ, and উত্তাপের ক্ষমতা.

findings.summary: The constant-voltage bullet used the awkward phrase তাপ শক্তি for heating power.
evidence: The previous bullet ended with ‘তাপ শক্তি বৃদ্ধি পায়’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the precise statement that heating power increases when resistance falls.

findings.summary: The safety paragraph retained the English loanword headroom.
evidence: The previous paragraph instructed the reader to use ‘হেডরুম’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the clearer Bengali phrase নিরাপত্তা মার্জিন.

findings.summary: The Joule example conclusion used an awkward rate construction and mixed unit styles.
evidence: The previous conclusion used ‘কুণ্ডলী প্রতি সেকেন্ডে 7.2 জুল’.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with the rate 7.2 J per second and the protected 72 J and 10 s notation.

findings.summary: The sine formula used English side terminology.
evidence: The previous expression used ‘opposite / hypotenuse’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘বিপরীত বাহু / কর্ণ’.

findings.summary: The cosine formula mixed English adjacent terminology with Bengali prose.
evidence: The previous expression used ‘adjacent / hypotenuse’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘সন্নিহিত বাহু / কর্ণ’.

findings.summary: The tangent formula used English side terminology.
evidence: The previous expression used ‘opposite / adjacent’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘বিপরীত বাহু / সন্নিহিত বাহু’.

findings.summary: The inverse-sine formula retained English side labels.
evidence: The previous expression used ‘opposite / hypotenuse’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Bengali labels for বিপরীত বাহু and কর্ণ.

findings.summary: The inverse-cosine formula retained English side labels.
evidence: The previous expression used ‘adjacent / hypotenuse’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Bengali labels for সন্নিহিত বাহু and কর্ণ.

findings.summary: The inverse-tangent formula retained English side labels.
evidence: The previous expression used ‘opposite / adjacent’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Bengali labels for বিপরীত বাহু and সন্নিহিত বাহু.

findings.summary: The heat-capacity description described a relationship rather than defining heat capacity directly.
evidence: The previous description said heat capacity connects transferred energy with temperature change.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as the energy required to change an object’s temperature.

findings.summary: The Q definition used an ungrammatical passive construction.
evidence: The previous bullet was ‘Q হল জুলে (J) তাপ শক্তি স্থানান্তরিত হয়।’
findings.resolution: Changed it to an explicit definition of transferred heat energy measured in joules.

findings.summary: The specific-heat definition used an imprecise literal term.
evidence: The previous bullet used ‘নির্দিষ্ট তাপ ক্ষমতা’.
findings.resolution: Standardized it to বিশিষ্ট তাপধারণ ক্ষমতা and retained J/(kg·K).

findings.summary: The ideal-heating setup used awkward punctuation and an unnatural loss clause.
evidence: The previous setup ended with ‘কোনও ক্ষতি নেই৷’.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as heating the example with a constant source without losses.

findings.summary: The heating-time conclusion spelled out the protected seconds unit.
evidence: The previous conclusion ended with ‘523 সেকেন্ড’.
findings.resolution: Restored the protected 523 s notation.

findings.summary: The area definition had an ungrammatical subject and object order.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘A হল সেই এলাকা যার মাধ্যমে তাপ বর্গ মিটার ... স্থানান্তরিত হয়’.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as the area through which heat is transferred, in m².

findings.summary: The heat-flux example title omitted the technical concept of flux density.
evidence: The previous title was ‘গড় হিটার প্রবাহ’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘হিটারের গড় তাপ প্রবাহ ঘনত্ব’.

findings.summary: The conduction title used an incorrect Bengali postposition and noun form.
evidence: The previous title was ‘একটি সমতল স্তর মাধ্যমে পরিবাহী’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘সমতল স্তরের মধ্য দিয়ে পরিবাহন’.

findings.summary: The radiation paragraph used an unclear Bengali rendering of emissivity.
evidence: The previous paragraph used ‘নির্গততা ε’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the clearer term নিঃসরণ ক্ষমতা.

findings.summary: The final unit-check instruction was grammatically incomplete.
evidence: The previous instruction was ‘শুধুমাত্র শেষে বৃত্তাকার তাই মধ্যবর্তী ফলাফল ...’.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as a complete instruction to round only at the end.
